policy.meaning: column is the timestamp column a row's age is measured from. interval is the interval literal of the TTL clause without its quotes, such as 30 days.

ptah.run/spanner/row-deletion-policy.constraint: The interval is a positive whole number of days in a spelling the owner reads. Neither string is blank. The value requests exactly this policy; its absence under complete source coverage requests none.
Values keep the spelling the server reports. Absence on a table under complete read coverage is an observed absence; incomplete inspection belongs in coverage.

canonicalization: Strings must be valid UTF-8 and are kept verbatim, including whitespace and case. Do not read the interval as a value; comparison owns that.
